properties.description:
Your Cohere-powered loan and mortgage workflow is deployed.

Launch the application
In the managed application menu, open Settings > Parameters and Outputs, then select frontendUrl. This is the primary application URL. Service endpoints are available as apiUrl and mcpUrl.

Microsoft Foundry
Use foundryProjectEndpoint to connect to the project and foundryProjectResourceId to open or automate against its Azure resource. The deployed resources and models are identified by foundryAccountName, foundryProjectName, modelDeploymentName, embedDeploymentName, embedModelName, rerankDeploymentName, and rerankModelName.

Retrieval and document processing
Azure AI Search details are available as searchServiceName and searchServiceEndpoint. Azure Document Intelligence details are available as documentIntelligenceAccountName and documentIntelligenceEndpoint.

Provisioning jobs
Use postDeployRunnerName to monitor the Entra-authenticated ACI runner. It starts and monitors policySeedJobName and provisioningJobName sequentially. fabricSeedDeploymentScriptName identifies the optional Fabric seed deployment script.

Optional Fabric integration
When Fabric integration is enabled, use fabricWorkspaceName and fabricLakehouseName to identify the provisioned Fabric assets.

Deployment readiness
ARM can complete while post-deployment initialization is still running. Confirm that the ACI runner reaches Succeeded before using the application; policy seeding and Foundry agent provisioning can take 15-30 minutes.
